purpose: Teach: といふ/劼/氣/ゎ/榮/佛/に当たりまして/翁

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、古文の「といふ」、つまり「という」の用法研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered the usage of the classical particle 「といふ」—that is, the modern 「という」—in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging nod. Conversational pace, slight lift at the end like confirming what she already knows. Genuine interest in his work, not testing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、漢字の劼、つまり「劼勉」の用法研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered the usage of the kanji 劼—the term 「劼勉」, diligent effort—in my paper.
lines.style: Quiet, focused. Slight pause before answering, like he's considering how to explain. Respectful but not stiff. Small, genuine voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「氣」、つまり気の文献研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, the old form 「氣」—the classical character for 気, 'spirit'—that was your research subject, wasn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, exploratory tone. Gentle push to see where he's going. Interested, not correcting. Slightly slower pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、小書きのゎ、つまり仮名の歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered the historical development of the small kana ゎ—the evolution of hiragana script—in my paper.
lines.style: Clear, direct answer. Slight tension—he knows she's testing him now, but stays grounded. Even delivery, no defensiveness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「榮」、つまり栄華の文献研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, the old form 「榮」—the classical character for 栄華, 'prosperity'—you examined that in your research, didn't you?
lines.style: Calm observation, like she's watching to see if he catches the pattern. Patient, not unkind. Deliberate pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、旧字「佛」、つまり仏教史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered the old form 「佛」—the historical development of Buddhist terminology—in my paper.
lines.style: Patient but starting to shift. Voice stays steady. Slight edge of awareness that something is off. No panic, just recognition.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、研究発表に当たりまして、序文の書き方を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, in preparing your presentation, you covered the methodology of writing an introduction in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Slower, more measured. Testing ground now explicit. Kind but direct. Watching his face. Not angry—concerned.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、隠居した翁、つまり老翁の民俗誌を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered the folklore and history of the retired hermit—the figure of the old sage—in my paper.
lines.style: Voice tightens slightly. Answer is still respectful but now he knows. No longer defensive—resigned. Small, final quality.
